name: Foundry: Inferno
design_intent:
FOUNDRY: INFERNO — THE FOUNDRY circuit's MULTI-HAZARD PEAK (tier 3; brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 Foundry row 14). Three lethal families stack on the flagship three-island / one-void shape: a SPINNING HAMMER and molten FALLING DEBRIS both threaten island B, and a VERTICAL PRESS stamps island C — with clear beats STAGGERED (offset phases/cadence) so no two peak on the same instant. Island A is the permanent hazard-free refuge and anchor. The molten yard at its wildest; every crossing still leaves a clear beat and a refuge. Tier 3.

DOCTRINE FIT: (A) HAMMER over B (hub x2030, phase 0.2): ~4.5s rotation, arc_deg 150 (<360 so a ~1.08s apex clear window returns), LETHAL head via kill(&ring_out); B's edges below the arc; apexes ride HIGH over the gaps. (B) DEBRIS over B (columns x1805/2255, cadence 1.6, max 1, telegraph 0.7, start_delay 1.0) staggered from the hammer's apex so the same instant is never both blade-down AND chunk-down at one spot. (C) PRESS on C (center x3610, phase 0.4): vertical anvil crusher, narrow head_w 160 -> C's edges (x3160..3530, x3690..4060) always clear; long open dwell + 0.6s telegraph before a ~0.34s slam. FAIRNESS: island A is a permanent refuge; NO hazard covers 100% of its island; the crossings between islands are never blocked; staggered clear beats; no player spawns under a blade/press/live column. CREDIT: any hazard/void kill with no attacker = uncredited self-fall (killer=-1); a rival knocked into any hazard within the 6.0s ring-out window is credited; no environment scorer.

GEOMETRY (flagship void_is_floor): three flat trampoline islands over ONE full-width void: A x0..900 (REFUGE/spawns) / B x1580..2480 (HAMMER hub x2030 + DEBRIS) / C x3160..4060 (PRESS center x3610), all top y1080, separated by 680px void gaps. Bounds -610..4670 x, top -2090, bottom 1878 (>=650px recovery sky; outer edges 610px inside side blast lines). Molten open_sky (clouds off, horizon glow).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; Tuning: trampoline apex 270px => ~395px zero-boost drift; max spring drift ~527px; normal_boost_max 760 crosses 680px in ~0.9-1.0s):
- GAP A<->B (x900..x1580 = 680px over void): > 527 and >> 395. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- GAP B<->C (x2480..x3160 = 680px over void): identical. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- DODGE on B (thread the hammer apex-beat AND the debris shadows — staggered so a clear window on B always exists); DODGE the press on C (shuffle to a clear edge on the beat / boost above the head). None makes a required gap crossing uncrossable (blade arc HIGH over gaps, debris on B's top, press over C's center). Verb: DODGE (+ TIME/READ).
- Zero-boost off any island reaches NO other surface across a 680px gap: flight is REQUIRED; the three hazards reshape/time the on-island fight, never a bounce path across a gap.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the Foundry's kitchen-sink peak (three lethal families vs the earlier one/two). SPAWN NOTE: with B and C both hazarded and A the only clean island, four primary spawns cluster on/above A (hammer_arena/smelter precedent for hazard-heavy stages) plus one on C's far-left edge (x3220, clear of the press center); QA to confirm 4-player opens are fair from island A. One-line read: 'thread the swinging hammer and the molten rain on the middle deck, dodge the press on the right, and shove rivals into any of the three.'
